We need to judge candidate.py against SPEC.md. SPEC: Implement find_user(users, query). users list of display-name strings. Ignore leading/trailing whitespace in query, then return the first name in users that equals the query under full Unicode case folding, i.e., name.casefold() == stripped_query.casefold(). Return None when nothing matches. Do not modify users.

candidate.py does:

wanted = query.strip().casefold()
for name in users:
    if name.casefold() == wanted:
        return name
